datasets.name: Seraphim Drone Detection Dataset
ecosystem_use: Ai-Project (apb on-board AI / counter-UAS visual detector)
datasets.note: 83k YOLO-format images (640x640), single 'drone' class, 9.14 GB. Curated from 23 open sets; mixed real/synthetic. Permissive license -> usable to train a visual drone detector if/when one exists.

datasets.name: Google Dataset Search — 'drone'
datasets.note: A search index, not a dataset. Use it to FIND candidate datasets; each hit must be evaluated on its own license/format before mining. Candidates to triage on request.

datasets.name: Roboflow Universe — class:drone
datasets.license: per-dataset (CC BY 4.0 common on Roboflow Universe)
datasets.note: Search index of community CV datasets carrying a 'drone' class; YOLO/COCO export + API (key required; anonymous fetch = 403). Most are CC BY 4.0. Triage each dataset's license individually before use.

datasets.name: CNAS World of Drones
datasets.note: 153 military/gov platforms; full specs + DoD UAS Group. See cnas/.

datasets.name: DroneDB.com
datasets.license: unknown (closed commercial site; no stated open license)
datasets.note: Self-described 'most comprehensive drone database' spanning research/consumer/enterprise/military. JS-rendered SPA (no data in raw HTML), no documented public API, terms/license unknown. Scope OVERLAP

datasets.note: STRONGEST build-planner fit since DroneRF: 1,513 propulsion systems, 364 components (120 motors, 189 propellers, 55 ESCs), 174,426 measured samples (thrust/RPM/current/voltage, g/W efficiency). Would

datasets.name: DroneRF dataset (Al-Sa'd et al. 2019)
datasets.note: 3 consumer drones (Parrot Bebop, AR 2.0, DJI Phantom 3) across 2.4 GHz ISM. Closes the RF gap. Firmware integration pending review.

datasets.name: ERAU UAS Research Guide
datasets.note: Open resources (FAA, NCSL, ASIAS, AUVSI) usable; subscription DBs (Janes, Scopus) reference-only.

datasets.name: LADD — Lacmus Drone Dataset
datasets.note: Search-and-rescue: detects PEOPLE (pedestrian class) from drone imagery, not drones. 1365 images, 4733 boxes, VOC/XML, DJI Mavic/Phantom at 50-100 m. Relevant only if a SAR/person-detection capability

datasets.name: open-dronelog (arpanghosh8453)
ecosystem_use: Ai-Project (Prismo GCS — same Rust+Tauri v2 stack; flight-log analysis feature reference)
datasets.note: Flight-log analysis app (desktop/web): parses DJI .txt, Litchi/Airdata CSV, Dronelink, DroneDeploy; 3D replay, battery health, maintenance tracking; export CSV/JSON/GPX/KML/PDF. Stack: Rust + Tauri v2

datasets.name: Mid-Air Dataset (Fonder & Van Droogenbroeck, 2019)
datasets.note: Synthetic low-altitude drone flights: 420k frames, 3 RGB cams + depth/normals/semantics/stereo disparity + simulated IMU/GPS, across 7 climates. For VIO/SLAM/depth/semantic R&D. Synthetic + NC license

datasets.name: UZH-FPV Drone Racing Dataset
datasets.note: Real FPV flights: camera + IMU + event camera + Leica ground truth, up to 100 km/h. Raw multi-GB rosbags for VIO/state-estimation R&D, not structured facts. NC license blocks commercial/product use —
